lines.zh: 我拖着几段不一样的身体往前走。
lines.en: I drag a body stitched from mismatched parts.

lines.zh: 走一步，喉咙里滚出一声低吼。
lines.en: Each step rolls a low growl out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我的腿数不对，可还是走得动。
lines.en: My legs are miscounted, yet they still work.

lines.zh: 草地被我踩出一串湿印。
lines.en: Wet prints trail behind me across the grass.

lines.zh: 我一路嗅着，找还活着的味道。
lines.en: I snuffle along, hunting the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 我歪着头走，因为脖子不太对。
lines.en: I walk with my head tilted; the neck is wrong.

lines.zh: 腐肉挂在我身上，走起来会响。
lines.en: Rotten flesh hangs off me and rattles as I move.

lines.zh: 我在夜里走得很慢，但不停。
lines.en: I walk slowly through the night, but never stop.

lines.zh: 骨头在我体内互相磕碰。
lines.en: Bones knock against each other inside me.

lines.zh: 我循着你的脚印，把草压平。
lines.en: I follow your footprints, flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 这具拼起来的身子，走一步响一下。
lines.en: This stitched body creaks with every step.

lines.zh: 我一走动，腐臭味就跟着走。
lines.en: Wherever I walk, the stench of rot follows.

lines.zh: 我站在原地低吼，没有原因。
lines.en: I stand and growl low, for no reason.

lines.zh: 几张嘴一起呼吸，不太整齐。
lines.en: Several mouths breathe together, out of sync.

lines.zh: 我挠了挠不知属于谁的肩膀。
lines.en: I scratch a shoulder that belonged to someone else.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜的味道从我肚子里冒出来。
lines.en: The smell of carrots leaks from inside me.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有几只手。
lines.en: I cannot count how many hands I have.

lines.zh: 骨头从皮肤里顶出来，我没管。
lines.en: Bone pushes through my skin and I leave it.

lines.zh: 我嚼着空气，像是在回忆。
lines.en: I chew on air, as if remembering.

lines.zh: 白天我躲在树影里，等人经过。
lines.en: By day I hide in tree shade, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音一直没停。
lines.en: The sound in my throat never stops.

lines.zh: 我身上拼着好几种东西。
lines.en: Several creatures are stitched into me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，几双眼睛一起看你。
lines.en: I lift my head and several eyes find you.

lines.zh: 你身上那股热气，让我喉咙发痒。
lines.en: The warmth off you makes my throat itch.

lines.zh: 我的低吼变得更长了一点。
lines.en: My growl stretches a little longer.

lines.zh: 我在想你的骨头能不能接上我。
lines.en: I wonder whether your bones would fit mine.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我歪头学你。
lines.en: You raise a weapon and I tilt my head, copying.

lines.zh: 我闻到腐肉，也闻到你。
lines.en: I smell rotten flesh, and I smell you.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，你可能以为我发呆。
lines.en: I stare so long you may think I am idle.

lines.zh: 我的视线来自不同方向。
lines.en: My gaze comes from several directions at once.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我退进暗处。
lines.en: You raise the torch and I retreat into the dark.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的走路方式。
lines.en: I have memorized the way you walk.

lines.zh: 刀砍开我的缝合处，缝线崩了一段。
lines.en: A blade splits my seam and a stitch snaps.

lines.zh: 我疼得低吼变成尖叫。
lines.en: The pain turns my growl into a shriek.

lines.zh: 腐肉从伤口掉出来，我捡回去。
lines.en: Rot falls from the wound and I pick it back up.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一条腿的用力。
lines.en: The blow breaks the push of one of my legs.

lines.zh: 腐肉从缝合处掉了一块下来。
lines.en: A piece of rotten flesh drops from my seams.

lines.zh: 骨头被砍出白印，声音很脆。
lines.en: The bone takes a white notch with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 不同部位同时在疼，很难忍。
lines.en: Different parts hurt at once, which is hard.

lines.zh: 我的血是几种颜色混在一起的。
lines.en: My blood is several colors mixed together.

lines.zh: 你砍中我时，我反而笑了。
lines.en: When you cut me, I laugh instead.

lines.zh: 我用手按住裂口，按住也没用。
lines.en: I press the split closed, and it does not help.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜一露出来，我喉咙就响了。
lines.en: A carrot appears and my throat starts rattling.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道让我挪不动脚。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh pins my feet.

lines.zh: 你把马铃薯举高，我伸手去够。
lines.en: You lift a potato and I reach for it.

lines.zh: 我吃什么都带着土味。
lines.en: Everything I eat tastes of soil.

lines.zh: 生肉的味道让我忘了疼。
lines.en: The smell of raw meat makes me forget pain.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住你手里的东西，连手一起。
lines.en: I bite what you hold, your hand included.

lines.zh: 骨头的响声对我像铃铛。
lines.en: The clatter of bones rings like a bell to me.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道走，不看路。
lines.en: I follow the smell and ignore the path.

lines.zh: 这顿饭我打算吃到天亮。
lines.en: I plan to make this meal last till dawn.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我已经在咽口水。
lines.en: By the time you back off, I am already salivating.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，摸到的是一堆缝合处。
lines.en: You bump me and your hand meets a seam of stitches.

lines.zh: 我身体太宽，走廊塞不下。
lines.en: My body is too wide for this corridor.

lines.zh: 我撞回去，肩上的骨头硌人。
lines.en: I shove back, bones on my shoulder jabbing.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，几块腐肉掉在地上。
lines.en: I lurch and a few chunks of rot fall off.

lines.zh: 被我挤到墙边的人都很安静。
lines.en: People pinned against walls by me go quiet.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起时，你听见低吼。
lines.en: Pressed against me, you hear the growl.

lines.zh: 我身上有味道，靠近就明白。
lines.en: I carry a smell you understand up close.

lines.zh: 我的手从奇怪的角度伸过来。
lines.en: My hand reaches out from a strange angle.

lines.zh: 你退开时，衣服上沾了黏液。
lines.en: You pull away with slime on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我平衡很差，撞一下要晃很久。
lines.en: My balance is poor; one bump makes me sway.

lines.zh: 我没见过第二个像我这样的。
lines.en: I have never met a second one like me.

lines.zh: 缝合的身体很难找到伴。
lines.en: A stitched body has trouble finding a partner.

lines.zh: 我摸到另一段腐肉，以为那是同类。
lines.en: I touch more rot and mistake it for kin.

lines.zh: 低吼在空地上没有回应。
lines.en: My growl gets no answer in the clearing.

lines.zh: 两只这样的东西相遇会先互相闻。
lines.en: Two of these would sniff each other first.

lines.zh: 我的身体是拼的，没有下一代。
lines.en: My body is assembled; there is no next generation.

lines.zh: 夜里我叫得比平时长。
lines.en: At night my call runs longer than usual.

lines.zh: 就算有伴，我也不知怎么靠近。
lines.en: Even with a partner, I would not know how to approach.

lines.zh: 我把腐肉推过去，算是示好。
lines.en: I push some rot toward it as a gesture.

lines.zh: 同伴的气味和食物的很像。
lines.en: A companion smells much like a meal.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的马铃薯，直接塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a potato and shove it straight in.

lines.zh: 一根骨头被我塞进肩上的洞。
lines.en: I slot a bone into a hole in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我把腐肉揣在身上，当作存粮。
lines.en: I tuck rotten flesh away as a store of food.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋滚过来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: A spawn egg rolls over and I sniff it.

lines.zh: 掉落的胡萝卜沾了泥，我照样吃。
lines.en: The dropped carrot is muddy; I eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的盾，不知道怎么用。
lines.en: I pick up your shield and do not know its use.

lines.zh: 东西太小，我手指夹不住。
lines.en: The thing is too small for my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西全往嘴里送。
lines.en: Everything I pick up goes toward my mouth.

lines.zh: 铁片卡在我的缝合口里。
lines.en: An iron scrap lodges in my seam.

lines.zh: 我蹲下捡东西时，骨头响成一片。
lines.en: As I crouch to pick things up, my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 我看见你，低吼变成短促的尖叫。
lines.en: I see you and my growl sharpens into a shriek.

lines.zh: 活物的味道从这里传来。
lines.en: The smell of something living comes from here.

lines.zh: 我不用挑目标，会动的都算。
lines.en: I do not choose targets; anything moving counts.

lines.zh: 你举起火把，反而让我更确定。
lines.en: You raise a torch, which only confirms it.

lines.zh: 我的几双眼睛同时转向你。
lines.en: All my eyes swing toward you at once.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的气味，跑不掉。
lines.en: I have your scent now; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 腐肉、骨头、胡萝卜，我什么都吃。
lines.en: Rotten flesh, bones, carrots. I eat it all.

lines.zh: 我开始朝你走，步子越来越快。
lines.en: I start toward you, my steps quickening.

lines.zh: 猎物在动，我就不需要想别的。
lines.en: Prey is moving, so I need nothing else.

lines.zh: 低吼停了，那说明我要动手了。
lines.en: The growl stops, which means I am about to move.

lines.zh: 你退到树后，我仍然知道方向。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I still know the way.

lines.zh: 我从几个方向同时感到饿。
lines.en: I feel hunger from several directions.

lines.zh: 缝合的身体里，有一部分先醒了。
lines.en: Part of this stitched body woke up first.

lines.zh: 你成了今天唯一的念头。
lines.en: You are the only thought I have today.

lines.zh: 我身上的眼睛一起睁开。
lines.en: Every eye on me opens at once.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的触须。
lines.en: You stepped on one of my tendrils.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，故意留出一段距离。
lines.en: I trail you, deliberately leaving a gap.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，只让喉咙响。
lines.en: You stop; I stop, letting my throat rattle.

lines.zh: 我在等你背对门的那一秒。
lines.en: I am waiting for the second you face the door.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很重，藏不住。
lines.en: My footsteps are heavy and betray me.

lines.zh: 你听得见我在几格外呼吸。
lines.en: You can hear me breathing blocks away.

lines.zh: 我从窗户那边绕，那里没有光。
lines.en: I go around by the window, where there is no light.

lines.zh: 这只手在抖，我按住它。
lines.en: This hand is trembling; I hold it still.

lines.zh: 你越快，我越高兴。
lines.en: The faster you go, the happier I am.

lines.zh: 我把门口的木板一块块推开。
lines.en: I push the planks from the doorway one by one.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味盖不住活人的味。
lines.en: The stink of rot cannot hide a living smell.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站了很久，没出声。
lines.en: I stood behind you a long while without a sound.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我爪子已经搭上来了。
lines.en: The moment you turn, my claws are already on you.

lines.zh: 低吼是我唯一忍住的东西。
lines.en: The growl is the one thing I hold back.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪里，我都有腿跟。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I have legs to follow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢围过去，不着急。
lines.en: I close in slowly. No rush.

lines.zh: 我的三条腿各走各的。
lines.en: My three legs each walk their own way.

lines.zh: 我停住，先听你的脚步。
lines.en: I stop and listen to your steps first.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有个声音在数数。
lines.en: Something in my throat is counting.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，贴地。
lines.en: I flatten myself against the ground.

lines.zh: 你退，我就顺着墙跟。
lines.en: You back away, and I follow the wall.

lines.zh: 我一把抓住你，骨头硌进你的肩。
lines.en: I grab you and bone digs into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下带着低吼砸下来。
lines.en: The blow comes down with a growl behind it.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的护甲，像撕腐肉。
lines.en: I tear your armor open like rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿并不都属于我。
lines.en: I bite down with teeth that are not all mine.

lines.zh: 你被打退，我跟着扑上去。
lines.en: You are knocked back and I lunge after you.

lines.zh: 我几下就累了，可我不会停。
lines.en: I tire quickly, but I will not stop.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的领口，拎了起来。
lines.en: My hand takes your collar and lifts.

lines.zh: 这一击把你打进了草里。
lines.en: This blow sends you into the grass.

lines.zh: 腐肉和骨头一起挥过去。
lines.en: Rot and bone swing at you together.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我照样把爪子落下。
lines.en: You cut me and my claws come down anyway.

lines.zh: 我压住你，身体比看起来重。
lines.en: I pin you; this body is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 打你的时候，我喉咙还在响。
lines.en: Even while striking, my throat keeps rattling.

lines.zh: 我撕下你的袖子，塞进了嘴里。
lines.en: I rip off your sleeve and stuff it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你倒地时，我歪头看你。
lines.en: When you fall, I tilt my head and look.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的护腿上。
lines.en: I sink my teeth into your leg guard.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从背后搭上来。
lines.en: My claws come up over your back.

lines.zh: 这一下是我借来的力气。
lines.en: This blow is strength I borrowed.

lines.zh: 我被砍断的一截还在动。
lines.en: The piece you cut off is still moving.

lines.zh: 我把你撞得退了半步。
lines.en: I knock you back half a step.

lines.zh: 你身上留下一道三道爪痕。
lines.en: Three claw lines stay on your skin.

lines.zh: 缝合线绷紧，我在这片黑暗里站起来。
lines.en: The stitches pull tight and I stand in the dark.

lines.zh: 腐肉、骨头、还有几根蔬菜拼成了我。
lines.en: Rotten flesh, bones, and a few vegetables assemble me.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，几张嘴同时喘气。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, several mouths gasped.

lines.zh: 我第一次低吼，把附近的鸟吓飞了。
lines.en: My first growl scattered the nearby birds.

lines.zh: 这具身体是别人留下的残渣。
lines.en: This body is the leftover scraps of others.

lines.zh: 我从土里爬出来，身上还带着根须。
lines.en: I crawl out of the soil still wearing roots.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我的缝合口，很白。
lines.en: The moon lights my seams white.

lines.zh: 我试了试腿，发现多了两条。
lines.en: I test my legs and find two extra.

lines.zh: 出生的地方有股烂菜味。
lines.en: The place of my birth smells of spoiled vegetables.

lines.zh: 我站直时，肩上的骨头顶了一下树。
lines.en: Standing up, a shoulder bone knocks the tree.

lines.zh: 我不知道这些东西原本属于谁。
lines.en: I do not know who these parts belonged to.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸就带着低吼。
lines.en: My very first breath came out as a growl.

lines.zh: 火沿着缝线烧，我拍不掉。
lines.en: Fire runs along my stitches and I cannot swat it.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，几块零件散了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and several parts scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进不该通的地方，我呛得厉害。
lines.en: Water enters places that should not connect; I choke.

lines.zh: 炸开的冲击把我身上的部件掀飞了。
lines.en: The blast throws pieces of me into the air.

lines.zh: 箭插在我背上，像多长了一根骨头。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like an extra bone.

lines.zh: 紫光灼过缝合处，线全焦了。
lines.en: Purple light scorches my seams and the thread burns.

lines.zh: 饿得我开始咬自己的手。
lines.en: Hunger makes me start biting my own hand.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，几条腿同时抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and several legs twitch at once.

lines.zh: 我掉进空白，身上的部件在散。
lines.en: I fall into the void and my parts come apart.
